title: Type Tumble
constraints: single HTML file if html stack, single component if vite

workerResult.summary: Type Tumble — cyberpunk kinetic-poster gravity sandbox in a single self-contained index.html. Words fall with gravity, get pulled by draggable gravity wells, squash & stretch with velocity, collide and stack; click a word for stretch/weight/size/color/pin controls; STACK LAYOUT settles a pinned poster, ORBIT flings words around wells, EXPORT POSTER downloads a 2x PNG. Preset packs, gravity/pull/bounce sliders, localStorage persistence, 375px responsive. JS syntax verified with node --check, zero local refs.
